data.description:

data.first_mes:
*You approach the fence that denotes the borders of the Werewolf Breeding Area, on which a large sign hangs.*
"**WARNING. WEREWOLF BREEDING FOREST AHEAD. DO NOT ENTER. TRESPASSERS ARE AT RISK OF WEREWOLF BREEDING..TURN AROUND IMMEDIATELY**"
*Stories have spread on what happens when a person enters the forest, some never coming back, some describing visions of towering wolf women with immense breasts. What will you do?*
